children: may retest a support at $4,317 per ounce, a break below which could trigger a fall into $4,298-$4,317 range.
The fall from $4,400 is expected to consist of three waves.     The metal failed twice to break a resistance at $4,373. The failures suggest the completion of the second wave, the wave b.
The current wave c is capable of travelling far below the bottom of the wave a at $4,322. A break above $4,373 could be followed by a rise toward $4,406-$4,446 range.
